description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know the Team The Anti-Abuse Engineering team builds applications to provide safety, security and bring trust in all of the high throughput systems, and services of Grab and its partners. It combats fraud in real-time, the team is composed of and skillful engineers who come together from different domains of technology. We take pride in building distributed systems that have an impact on the lives of millions of users in our endeavor to out-serve the underserved population.
